NDT Level III consulting in Corpus Christi: refinery, LNG, export-terminal and fabrication-yard programs, and how local providers compare

Corpus Christi's NDT market is dominated by inspection companies working turnarounds and terminal projects. Harder to find locally is a Level III whose job is your program rather than your inspection schedule: someone to keep a contractor's written practice current, write procedures for a new scope, examine technicians and prepare the company for an operator or class audit. Atlantis does that work as NDT Level 3 consulting services from Houston, about three and a half hours up the coast, with visits when an examination or audit needs one.

What do Coastal Bend companies ask a Level III for?

  • Turnaround contractors serving the ship channel refineries: procedure sets matched to each operator's NDT specification, and Level II examinations completed before the roster goes in.
  • LNG and cryogenic work: procedures for stainless and nickel-alloy welds, where penetrant and ultrasonic techniques need care; see written practices for LNG.
  • Export terminals and tank farms in Ingleside and along the La Quinta Channel: personnel and procedure records that support the owner's tank and piping inspection plans.
  • Skid and module fabricators, including shops building to DNV or another class society's rules: procedures that satisfy both the construction code and the class rules.

Rules that apply to Corpus Christi NDT programs

LNG plants are regulated by PHMSA under 49 CFR Part 193, on top of the owner's own specifications, and Texas boilers and pressure vessels sit with the TDLR Boiler Program. Radiography on a Coastal Bend site is performed by the owner's licensed radiography contractor, whose radiographers carry Texas Department of State Health Services certification; Atlantis can review those radiographs as a Level III but does not perform radiography in the US. Fabricators working to class rules should read them early, because a class society can set its own requirements for NDT personnel and acceptance, and an SNT-TC-1A program may need a bridging document to meet them.

Gaps a Level III tends to find in coastal contractor programs

  • Certification files for technicians hired at a turnaround peak, with experience hours claimed but not documented.
  • Procedures still citing a superseded ASME Section V edition after the operator's specification has moved on.
  • Penetrant procedures for stainless and nickel-alloy work that do not address the sulfur and halogen limits on penetrant materials that Section V sets for those alloys.
  • Ultrasonic thickness procedures with no correction or verification step for readings taken on hot equipment.

Searching for IRISNDT in Corpus Christi? How the local options differ

IRISNDT, which appears as Apave America Inc. on its job postings, lists Corpus Christi among its Texas locations, with service lines in NDT and radiography, API inspection and engineering. Mistras's Corpus Christi branch lists conventional NDT, API 510, 570 and 653 inspection, rope access and turnaround services, and Acuren has a Corpus Christi office on North Lexington. These companies are the right call when you need technicians on a unit. Their pages lead with inspection, so if what you need is a Level III to own your written practice, ask directly whether that is a separate service and who would hold the signature. The larger operators also keep in-house Level IIIs, and a remote outsourced Level III is the fourth option.

How to vet an NDT Level III consultant on the Coastal Bend

  1. Confirm that each method on the ASNT certificate matches what your technicians perform on the channel.
  2. Ask for a redacted procedure written to an operator's NDT specification, and check that its acceptance criteria are traceable.
  3. For class or LNG work, ask what bridging they have done between an SNT-TC-1A program and a project's personnel rules.
  4. If the consultant also bids against you for inspection on the same sites, think hard before handing over your procedures.
  5. Agree how quickly audit questions get answered during a turnaround, when nobody can wait a week.

How Atlantis supports Corpus Christi companies

Every engagement is led by Anoop Rayavarapu, ASNT NDT Level III certified in UT, RT, MT, PT and VT. Drafting of written practices, procedures and audit packs happens remotely; practical examinations and audits are scheduled at your yard or shop.
